extension.summary: 言語設定マネージャー
extension.description: 根据你的语言偏好自动选择音轨与字幕轨道
Sets the audio and subtitle track according to your language preferences
Ställer in ljud- och undertextspår enligt dina språkinställningar
Imposta le tracce audio e dei sottotitoli in base alle preferenze linguistiche.
言語設定に従って音声トラックと字幕トラックを設定します。
Legt die Audio- und Untertitelspur entsprechend Ihren Spracheinstellungen fest
Définit les pistes audio et de sous-titres selon vos préférences linguistiques

extension.news: 1.1.1Beta2 : - Builds on 1.1.1Beta1. - Regional/script language variants (English UK/US/Australia/India/Canada, Spanish Spain/Latin America, French France/Canada/Belgium/Switzerland, Portuguese Portugal/Brazil, Chinese Simplified/Traditional, German Switzerland/Austria, Dutch Belgium) share one engine; the region is read from the track tag, title or external subtitle file name. - New "Sub converter": ASS/SSA and other text subtitles keep their styles, only bottom lines move to the top. - New: subtitle format preference (issue #30): rank SRT, ASS/SSA, WebVTT, PGS and VobSub in General settings; among subtitles that fit your language preference equally well, the first format of your list that is present is used. - Reworked seekback / "Fast Subtitles Display" ("Start & Resume" by default). - Regex subtitle filter fixes; external subtitle languages read from file names; safer stored preferences. - The settings values of the 1.1.1Beta1 language variants were renumbered: re-select regional languages in settings. 1.1.1Beta1 : - Add regional/script language preferences for English, French, Spanish, Portuguese and Chinese, grouped with their base language in settings (Thanks to Hugs11). - Prefer exact BCP-47 tags or recognized track-title variants, then unlabelled tracks of the same language; preserve generic language preferences (Thanks to Hugs11). - Add Chinese translation (Thanks to wabisabi926). - Avoid some wrong seekback decisions in subtitles delayed workaround.
